Approve reviewed analysis tasks

Source: R/analysis-plan.R
approve_plan.Rd

Approval is explicit and can only promote tasks that have completed preflight validation. Invalid tasks cannot be approved.

Usage

approve_plan(plan, analysis_id = NULL)

Arguments

plan

A validated analysis_plan.

analysis_id

Optional character vector of analysis identifiers. If omitted, all tasks currently in review are selected.

Value

An updated analysis_plan.
